record.remarks:
***HUGE PRICE IMPROVEMENT!!***  Welcome to 29603 Highpoint Road - Where the Coast Meets Elevated Living!
Few addresses on the Palos Verdes Peninsula command attention quite like this one. Nestled within the sought-after enclave of Miraleste Hills, this beautifully appointed 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom residence delivers the kind of panoramic ocean and harbor views that make every morning feel like a getaway — visible from nearly every room in the home.
Set on a tranquil cul-de-sac framed by mature trees and thoughtfully curated landscaping, the property offers an uncommon combination of seclusion and accessibility. Situated well over 5 miles from the landslide zone and with the fire department just minutes away, this home provides both peace of mind and peace of scenery.
Step inside and discover a flowing floor plan designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. The main level opens into a generous living area that transitions naturally into a formal dining space — equally suited for intimate dinners or lively gatherings. The kitchen anchors the heart of the home with rich cabinetry, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and clean sightlines that keep the cook connected to the action. Adjacent, the family room invites you to settle in around a classic fireplace with a built-in wet bar nearby — the kind of space that guests tend to linger in.
Upstairs, four well-proportioned bedrooms offer flexibility for family, guests, or a dedicated home office. The primary suite is a true retreat — featuring a custom walk-in closet, a spa-inspired ensuite with soaking tub and walk-in shower, and a private balcony where ocean breezes and coastal vistas greet you each morning. No power lines. Just horizon.
Additional highlights include central air conditioning, a full laundry room, an attached two-car garage with storage, and generous additional parking. Outdoor living is equally impressive, with patios accessible from both the kitchen and family room — perfect for al fresco dining — plus a manicured front lawn that doubles as one of the best sunset-viewing spots in the neighborhood.
With nearly $200,000 in recent upgrades throughout and proximity to top-rated schools, premier dining, and coastal destinations, this is a rare opportunity to plant roots in one of RPV's most prestigious and enduring communities.

record.remarks:
Life on Newport Harbor begins here, where timeless coastal charm meets coveted bay front living. Set on a rare oversized bayfront lot—approximately one and a half standard lots—on Balboa Island, this property offers 45 feet of frontage, a private pier and dock with room for multiple boats with easy nautical access to the harbor entrance, and ultraconvenient on-and-off-island access.

  It is an exceptional opportunity to own one of the island’s prized waterfront settings. Inside, four bedrooms and four baths (two full and two three-quarters) are complemented by sandy shoreline access and sweeping harbor views in one of Newport Beach’s most iconic locations. Throughout the home, bright interiors blend warmth and character with hardwood flooring, new vinyl plank flooring in the kitchen and downstairs baths, and newly painted interiors and exteriors. Expansive windows and inviting living spaces are designed to capture water views from nearly every angle. Centering the main living room, a striking brick fireplace wall creates a welcoming focal point, while multiple gathering areas flow seamlessly to outdoor patios and charming entertaining courtyards. The updated main kitchen showcases crisp white cabinetry and new quartz countertops. Spanning just over 2,000 square feet, the thoughtfully arranged floorplan features two distinct wings, creating privacy and versatility. Upstairs is a living area, bedroom, full bath and kitchenette that was used as a spacious master suite and office. Upstairs features an elevated terrace which adds another open-air escape for lounging above it all. With a primary bedroom also downstairs, the upstairs alternatively it could be ideal for large families, multigenerational living, visitors or extended stays.

   Located within the secondary wing is a separate one bedroom, three-quarter bath guest quarters with private patio-only access. Along the water, a private pier and dock with room for multiple boats provides access for boating, paddleboarding, kayaking, and effortless harbor enjoyment. Completing the residence is an oversized attached two-car garage. Just moments away, Balboa Island’s Marine Avenue boutiques and dining, waterfront restaurants, yacht clubs, Peninsula beaches, and world-class. Newport Harbor recreation await. Exceptional opportunity to own an authentic North Bayfront home surrounded by some of coastal Orange County’s most sought-after real estate.

record.remarks:
Welcome to 6050 E. Malton in East Simi Valley—a beautifully maintained, move-in-ready home where many of the major high-ticket improvements have already been completed.

The stunning gourmet kitchen was remodeled in 2025 and features quartz countertops, custom cabinetry, a center island with built-in microwave, recessed lighting, and a built-in bar designed for both everyday living and entertaining. High-end appliances include a six-burner gas range with oven, stainless steel refrigerator, and dishwasher. All major appliances are included with the sale, including the washer and dryer.

Additional upgrades include a new HVAC system, whole-house fan, brand-new windows throughout, brand-new shutters, upgraded sliding glass doors, copper plumbing, and an emergency generator transfer-switch system with the generator included.

The bright and inviting interior offers an open dining area and a step-down living room featuring a fireplace and bay window. Ceiling fans throughout the home provide additional comfort.

The backyard is designed for relaxation and entertaining, with mature landscaping, a greenhouse, beautifully maintained grounds, and a spacious covered patio with three ceiling fans. An approximately one-year-old spa and gazebo are also included with the sale, creating a private outdoor retreat ready to enjoy.

Additional conveniences include a separate laundry room, abundant storage, a finished two-car garage with generous workspace, and a security system that will remain with the property.

6050 E. Malton combines extensive recent improvements, thoughtful amenities, and inviting indoor-outdoor living in a desirable East Simi Valley location—truly a home ready for its next owner to move in and enjoy.
